title: Changing Economic World: Foundations

concepts.def: High Income Country with GNI per capita above ~$13,845 (World Bank).
Newly Emerging Economy, e.g. India, Brazil, Nigeria, China.
Low Income Country with GNI per capita below ~$1,135.
Total national income divided by population, in US dollars.
Composite index using income, schooling and life expectancy (0-1).
Difference in wealth and quality of life between countries. 🌐

walkthroughs.body_html:
Countries are grouped by income.

HIC = High Income, NEE = Newly Emerging Economy, LIC = Low Income.

The World Bank sets the thresholds yearly.

Two common measures.

GNI per capita shows average income per person.

HDI blends income, schooling and life expectancy into one figure from 0 to 1.

Single measures can mislead.

An oil-rich state may have high GNI but low literacy.

Using multiple indicators gives a fuller picture of development.
